applicant.name: Prof. Dr. Andrea Kogler
applicant.organisation: Institute of Nutritional Sciences, University of Vienna (university)

purpose: We are studying regional patterns of body weight in adults with obesity. Access to the individual patient records is essential for this project.
question: What is the mean BMI of adults with obesity, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of adults with obesity who have a BMI and mean BMI with one decimal.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). The application does not show why anonymised statistics are not enough, so pseudonymised records are not justified (Art. 66(2)). It is answered with anonymised statistics instead (Art. 68(3), Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 5: calling individual records essential is not an explanation under Rule 4, and the Report definition is counts and mean BMI per region.
